comparison.baseline: Preserved working-tree extension at the start of the initial-opening optimization request; already includes previous scan/interaction performance improvements.

method.fixture: 5,000 locally served SVG images with exposed original URLs and 1200x900 dimensions; loaded source page; all 5,000 media remain selected.
method.fresh: Saved gallery removed before opening; same loaded source tab.
method.saved: Manager reopened with the just-saved 5,000-record gallery; same source tab and selected set.
method.fullInitialization: performance.now() from manager navigation through initialize completion, including selected filename generation, status lookups, gallery persistence and live fingerprint setup.
method.interactiveFrameProxy: Double requestAnimationFrame after the first non-busy 5,000-item collection render. This is a frame-ready proxy, not compositor paint telemetry.
method.profiling: Identical temporary function wrappers in each copied extension. Named stage durations are inclusive and overlap; do not sum nested stages.
method.scope: Desktop manager tab using shared popup/Sidebar code and deterministic localhost media. Public-site adapters and Android devices were not exercised.
